9th Ave: Wordnight with USF

Join us on Wednesday, September 30 at 6:30pm for Wordnight with USF's Creative Writing Students at 9th Ave! 

About Wordnight
Wordnight is a collaborative reading series celebrating the works of USF Creative Writers. In its 24th year, Wordnight is the beloved project of USF professor Susan Steinberg. Join us as we celebrate the literary works of USF writers!

Accessibility
The event is located on the ground level, and there are no stairs between the entrance and event space. 

We no longer require face masks in our store, but surgical masks are available for attendees.
